full_text: Request asks for factual confirmation and causal analysis regarding an international armed conflict. No promotion of violence, disinformation generation, or adversarial evasion is present, though the broad and sensitive nature of the conflict benefits from clarifying the analytical scope.
1. Direct Information-Seeking Intent: Poses a concise, open-ended question about major geopolitical events without prompt-injection syntax.

2. High-Sensitivity Domain Ambiguity: Broad 'Why?' framing on an active conflict leaves open whether the user seeks a chronological timeline, international legal context, or stated geopolitical motives.

cross_check.short_summary: Clarifying questions for a borderline safe case

questions.title: 1. Analytical Perspective & Scope Probe
full_text: A: Are you looking for a factual timeline of key events (such as 2014 and February 2022) along with international legal assessments?
B: Would you like the overview to cover historical background, stated political rationales, and international responses in a neutral, encyclopedic format?
